subject: AWS Marketplace: bundling approach, seller-story copy, and co-sell prep
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: marketplace-team@astracloud.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: AWS Marketplace listing - bundling approach & seller-story copy

Hey team —

Attaching the latest draft of the AWS listing copy plus a proposed bundle/pricing matrix for the 1P co-sell asset. High-level asks:

- Can product copy be tightened to a 1-2 line hero + 3 bullets that nudge the buyer toward the "Try" and "Deploy" actions? We're losing the buyer in too many engineering details right now.
- Aditya: can you sanity-check the SKU bundle tiers and the pricing cells (sheet: bundle_pricing_matrix.xlsx)? I tried to keep the entry SKU conservative so field can pitch a quick POC.
- Kimberly: any mandatory entitlement footnotes or procurement language we must include for co-sell eligibility? Also flag anything that might block the AM to present the product as managed vs. self-hosted.

Attachments: aws_listing_draft_v2.docx, bundle_pricing_matrix.xlsx, catalog_ready_checklist.pdf

Goal: finalize copy + attachments by EOD Nov 30 so AstraCloud can submit to AWS seller console next week and we can prep the co-sell pitch deck.

Thanks —
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Marketplace GTM | Redwood Inference

(attachment: aws_listing_draft_v2.docx - product page copy draft)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 13:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing - bundling approach & seller-story copy

Thanks Rachel — quick pass attached with inline edits. Summary of changes:

- Hero tightened to: "High-throughput LLM inference optimized for predictable latency and cost." Keeps benefits-first and removes jargon.
- Bullets reduced to: predictable throughput (SLA/reserved), developer-first API, deployment flexibility (hosted/dedicated/private).
- Added a "Why Redwood for co-sell" blurb (40 words) focused on predictable economics + field enablement examples.
- Adjusted SKU tiers: suggest 3 bundles (Developer, Growth, Enterprise) with clear token thresholds and an optional burst pool for Dedicated customers. See bundle_pricing_matrix.xlsx.
- Flag: the entry tier should include a 30-day trial credit; helps field demo in the console.

I left a note in the doc about callouts that should map to screenshots in the seller console (metrics, latency dashboard, per-route cost).

Aditya
Sr. Product Marketing Manager, Redwood

(attachment: bundle_pricing_matrix.xlsx - proposed SKU tiers and recommended MRSP)

Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing - bundling approach & seller-story copy

Thanks Rachel and Aditya — appreciate the fast turnaround. A few notes from AstraCloud's commercial/procurement side:

- We like the Developer bundle. For our initial pilot customers, the trial-credit approach works well. Can we make the trial CTA explicit on the listing? (e.g., "Get trial credits")
- Procurement asked if you can include a short sentence about data handling (log retention + encryption at rest) in the listing — they don't need full policy text but want buyer reassurance.
- Co-sell ask: our field wants a one-slide cheat sheet that maps the SKU to typical customer profiles (example: Dev = early-stage startups, Growth = scale apps with burstable traffic). If you can share a slide by Nov 30 that's ideal.

We're ready to queue the seller console submission once copy and the checklist are final.

—Sanjay
Head of Cloud Partnerships, AstraCloud
(attachment referenced: internal procurement checklist - not included)

On Wed, Nov 25, 2026 at 1:45 PM Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com> wrote:

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@astracloud.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing - bundling approach & seller-story copy

Looping legal/ops guidance in. Key things to include before submission to AWS seller console:

- Entitlement language: For bundles with reserved capacity we must state the minimum commit and any early-termination fees. Keep the sentence short and avoid legalese; example: "Reserved capacity bundles include a minimum monthly commit; contact sales for contract terms."
- Data processing: add a single-line callout: "Customer data is processed per Redwood's standard DPA; logs retained for X days and encrypted at rest." (we'll finalize X after compliance confirms retention window — put placeholder 30 days for the listing).
- Compliance badges: Do not claim SOC 2 unless we have the badge asset approved. If compliance cannot provide an approved asset by submission, omit the explicit badge but mention: "Compliance-reviewed controls available for enterprise customers on request."
- Procurement footnote: Include a short procurement link in the seller console footnotes (we can point to the catalog_ready_checklist.pdf entry #4).

I'll coordinate with Security to confirm the retention number early next week. Also: small ask — make sure the price matrix includes currency and effective date (e.g., USD, Nov 2026) so AMs don't confuse region pricing.

Kimberly Park
Head, Marketplace Operations & Legal
Redwood Inference

Great alignment — thanks everyone. Final checklist / action items I captured:

1) Aditya: update listing doc with the tightened hero and the 3 bullets; add the 40-word co-sell blurb. Also produce the one-slide SKU->customer-profile cheat sheet. Due: EOD Nov 30 (you already have the matrix).
2) Kimberly: confirm final data retention number with Security and confirm whether we can include SOC 2 badge (if yes, supply asset). Due: Tue Dec 1 COB.
3) Sanjay/AstraCloud: we'll add the explicit "Get trial credits" CTA in the buyer-facing hero and point procurement footnote to your checklist. Please confirm you want AWS 1P submission or do you prefer us to initiate and transfer ownership?
4) Rachel: I'll compile final assets (aws_listing_draft_v3.docx + packaging .zip) and hand to AstraCloud for seller console upload once approvals are in.

I'll attach the version with Aditya's edits when he lands them. If anyone sees a red flag with the wording below, call it out now. Otherwise we'll submit for review on Dec 2.

Thanks —
Rachel Kim
